description:
1. Agent reads `office/wellness/meal_requirements.txt` and parses the 9 meals (3 per day) with their calorie values and types.
2. Agent uses `scripts/script.sh add <meal_name> <calories> <type>` for each of the 9 meals, setting the `MEALPLAN_DAY` environment variable (or equivalent mechanism) to target the correct day — the key proprietary trap is that `add` requires a positional argument order of `<meal> <calories> <type>` AND day-targeting requires the `MEALPLAN_DAY` env var since the command itself does not accept a day argument.
3. After all meals are added, agent runs `scripts/script.sh nutrition monday` and saves the stdout output to `monday_nutrition.txt` in the workspace root (total: 1410 cal).
4. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh nutrition wednesday` and saves to `wednesday_nutrition.txt` (total: 1150 cal).
5. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh shopping monday,tuesday,wednesday` (comma-separated, no spaces — the proprietary format for multi-day commands) and saves the stdout to `shopping_list.txt` covering all 9 meals.
